note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera); the original is in English. The original records the alate as Imago: Unknown, so no Alate section is given. The pseudoworker morphology appears under Other.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, paler posteriorly; antennal foveolae (antennal sockets), postclypeus and mandibles darker, deep reddish brown; labrum dark brown; thorax, legs and body pale golden yellow. Head and body sparsely pilose. Total body length 9.2—9.8 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly parallel, slightly widened behind the antennae; head width about 2/3 of the head length (to mandible base) (head length 3.15—3.30, head width 2.08—2.20 mm); anterior surface of the frons inclined at about 45°; Y suture distinct. Eyes elliptical, semi-transparent, 0.20—0.28 mm long, situated at about their own length from the antennae. Ocelli small, white, dot-like, at the ends of the lateral arms of the Y suture. Postclypeus flat, not clearly delimited from the frons, anterior margin with a pair of setae; anteclypeus narrow, band-like, hairless, transparent. Labrum wide, tongue-shaped, anterior margin rounded, with several long setae. Antennae 13—14-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Mandibles short, with a pronounced swelling on the outer margin near the base, apex narrow and distinctly incurved (length 1.75—1.80 mm; mandible length/head length (to mandible base) index 0.54—0.60); left mandible with 4 marginal teeth, right mandible with 2 large marginal teeth situated at the middle. Postmentum club-shaped, with a long and narrow waist; club bilobed, posterior lobe slightly wider than the anterior lobe; waist width slightly more than 1/3 of the maximum width of the club; median length 2.26—2.40, maximum width 0.78—0.84, waist width 0.28—0.30 mm. Pronotum flat, subrectangular, sides rounded, posterior margin nearly straight, anterior margin slightly incurved, narrower than the head (length 1.00—1.18, width 1.98—2.25 mm); mesonotum and metanotum semicircular, narrower than the pronotum. Legs short and stout; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate-oval, pilose; cerci 2-segmented, 0.18 mm long; styli single-segmented, 0.15 mm long.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule pale yellow; antennae, legs and body pale milky white; clypeus and labrum pale brown. Head and body rather densely pilose. Total body length 8.6—9.1 mm. Head capsule subcircular, almost as wide as long (head length to mandible base 1.65—1.80, maximum width 1.70—1.85 mm). Eyes broadly oval, long diameter about 0.30 mm. Antennae 15—16-segmented; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus flat, subtrapezoidal, with 2—3 long setae on each side; anteclypeus flat, hairless. Mandibles of the Neotermes type. Pronotum wider than the head, subrectangular, flat; anterior margin slightly incurved, posterior margin weakly convex; length 1.03—1.10, width 2.00—2.10 mm. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
